title: Guiding the Way: A Comprehensive Examination of AI Guidelines in Global Media

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping the geographical and temporal distribution of 37 media AI guidelines globally to quantify and analyze the dominance of WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) nations compared to the Global South in establishing AI norms.

Applying Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling and qualitative thematic analysis to the text of media AI guidelines to evaluate how news organizations formulate policies around bias mitigation, fairness, and human-in-the-loop oversight.

Qualitative textual analysis identifying gaps in current AI guidelines, specifically evaluating their failure to comprehensively address risks related to language, ethnicity, color, and local socio-cultural nuances in non-Western contexts.
